newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish tv stations in deal on soccer rights.
newsitem.headline: Spanish tv stations in deal on soccer rights.

text.p: Three Spanish television channels will create a new company to coordinate broadcasts of soccer matches.
Antenna 3, Television de Catalunya and Canal plus will join in the new venture, they said in statements received on Thursday.
The statements gave no financial details and said the deal will concern Spanish first and second division league soccer and the Copa del Rey (King's Cup).
Antena 3 owner Antonio Asensio will be the chairman of the new firm. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
